description: This file defines the 'vrb_alloc' structure for VRB resource allocation in a wireless communication system, including methods for managing different allocation types, conversion functions, and formatting support.

classes.name: vrb_alloc
classes.description: A structure representing VRB resource allocation, supporting two types: RBG bitmap and VRB interval.

methods.name: is_type0
methods.description: Checks if the allocation is of type0 (RBG bitmap).

methods.name: is_type1
methods.description: Checks if the allocation is of type1 (VRB interval).

methods.name: type0
methods.description: Returns the RBG bitmap if allocation is of type0; asserts otherwise.

methods.name: type1
methods.description: Returns the VRB interval if allocation is of type1; asserts otherwise.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Checks if the allocation is non-empty.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the allocation is empty.
